mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPIAUCSL above 250 and INDPRO below 107 signals stagflation risk, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to deteriorating economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 250 and INDPRO < 107.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1200), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to valuation concerns and reduced growth momentum, producing negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market strength (HOUST > 1200) signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving economic conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases month-over-month.
